name: L10 LSAA Vienna adaptive portal credential fields lexical Development
question: Can frozen PP-OCRv6 medium recover exact small address tokens on provider-, city-, and selected-building-disjoint LSAA Vienna facades when each strong portal receives a larger high-resolution credential field, without converting proximity into a portal-ownership binding?

cohort.selected_building_rule: All 48 selected OSM buildings, facade members, and panorama IDs are unique across Development and confirmation holdout.
cohort.confirmation_holdout: No confirmation facade pixel may be materialized or reviewed during this Development run.

adaptive_credential_observation.selection: Top portals by the unchanged frozen segmentation confidence; no evaluator box or pixel truth enters inference.
adaptive_credential_observation.binding_policy: An exact token in a portal-relative field is lexical evidence plus a non-authoritative proximity edge. It never emits selected_binding because proximity does not establish address-to-door ownership.

research_basis.title: Scene Text Telescope: Text-Focused Scene Image Super-Resolution
research_basis.use: Supports treating low-resolution scene text as a local high-resolution observation problem. The present mechanism uses deterministic crop magnification, not the paper's learned super-resolution model.

research_basis.title: Spatially Aware Multimodal Transformers for TextVQA
research_basis.use: Supports explicit local object-OCR spatial edges. The present mechanism records a proximity edge but deliberately withholds ownership authority.

execution_rule: Freeze evaluator, source, metadata truth, pre-inference human pixel truth, materialization hashes, unchanged models, adaptive field geometry, gates, and control semantics before one output-bearing Development invocation. Do not inspect confirmation pixels.
claim_boundary: A pass is provider-, city-, and selected-building-disjoint LSAA Development evidence that portal-relative high-resolution fields improve exact lexical observation under this curated cohort while adding no portal binding. It is not fresh confirmation and does not establish address-to-door ownership, entrance affordance, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety.
non_claims: LSAA official single-door boxes are evaluator annotations and do not enter inference.
A text token observed near a portal is not evidence that the address owns that portal.
The source-disjoint Development cohort is consumed by this run and cannot later supply confirmation authority.
The confirmation holdout remains pixel-closed until a separate mechanism and confirmation protocol are frozen.
